title: See the two types of recording rule

blocks.title: See the two types of recording rule

blocks.content: Open the **Alert rules** page with the recording rules listed.
Find the **Rule source** filter. Its options are **All**, **Grafana managed**, and **Data source managed**.
Grafana has two types of recording rule. The type determines which data sources the recording rule can query.
Select **Grafana managed**. The list now shows only Grafana-managed recording rules.
A Grafana-managed recording rule can query a wide range of data sources. This type is recommended and is enabled by default in Grafana Cloud.
Select **Data source managed**. The list now shows only data source-managed recording rules.
A data source-managed recording rule can query Prometheus-based data sources such as Mimir or Loki.
